data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided scientific-educational figure with a very small masked correction, preserving the entire layout and all non-requested elements exactly. Keep the camera registers c=[P,E,G] unchanged, keep the P, E, G boxes unchanged, and do not redraw the whole figure.

Required edit:
- Remove all red backward-gradient arrows that point upward into the green-labeled speed box ||v_t||.
- Do NOT add any red arrow into speed.
- Speed must remain a black forward input only.
- Preserve or redraw a clean red gradient route that bypasses speed and indicates gradients go to P, E, G only.
- Keep the red label inside the loss box reading “gradient to P, E, G”.
- If the gray bottom note is visible, update it to read exactly: “no gradients to D_raw, Omega, speed, or renderer R”.

Do not change:
- Do not alter the P, E, G boxes.
- Do not alter the S_phi block, factor chips, Q/M blocks, output images, or legend.
- Do not alter the black forward arrows.
- Do not redraw the whole figure.

Avoid:
- Avoid red arrows to speed, Omega, scene mask, D_raw, or renderer R.
- Avoid covering black forward arrows.

Style: keep the original crisp vector-diagram look, typography, and colors; only perform the minimal localized correction in the masked region.
